summary: Phase C+D verification. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_phase_c_d.py covering all 6 requested items -> 13 passed, 1 skipped (skip is expected: merchant is already approved so save_shop is intentionally locked; the single-category cap is enforced by both the frontend button-onClick handler and by save_shop() line 249 `cats = cats[:1]`). Frontend spot-checks confirmed the visible removals/behaviours where the UI was reachable in-automation.
critical_code_review_comments: #3 merchant single-category: merchant_reg_service.save_shop line 249 caps `cats = cats[:1]` after building the resolved list; MerchantRegistration.jsx line 333 uses `on ? [] : [{...}]` — clicking any category replaces the previous selection so at most one stays highlighted. Server also mirrors the same 1-cap when admin proxy /api/admin/merchants/{uid}/reg/shop is used. Test skipped only because demo merchant is already approved (save endpoint returns 400 'approved and locked' by design).

#4 merchant lock: MerchantRegistration.jsx line 178 `editable = adminEdit || (status !== 'approved' && status !== 'under_review')`. All inputs pass `disabled={!editable}` and the whole content wrapper gets `.reg-readonly` when not editable. After submit, backend flips profile.status to 'under_review' AND users.kyc_status to 'under_review', so the UI locks immediately on next profile fetch. An `under_review` banner shows via `{status === 'under_review' && (...)}` line 232.

#11 bank/KYC PDF preview: Person360.jsx and MerchantBankKycAdmin/DocCard determine docKind by URL extension and render a PDF tile + iframe lightbox for PDFs, inline for images. Backend admin partner overview response includes the bank/kyc doc URLs — confirmed via /api/admin/people/partner/{id}/overview returning bank_* / passbook / cheque / aadhaar / pan_url fields for seeded partners.

#12 customer category filter: CustomerDashboard.jsx line 281 tile onClick -> `navigate('/services?category=' + id)`; Services.jsx line 63 reads `initialCat` from the URL and line 94-97 filters services by `s.category_id === activeCat`. Public GET /api/catalog/services?category_id=<id> returned only that category's services with status=='active' for every category tested.

#6 trigger events: template_service.delete_event for a built-in key writes hidden=true (upsert) instead of deleting the code entry, and list_events skips hidden — so a built-in disappears from admin UI + fire_event skips it (line 230). Re-creating via POST /template-events with the same key clears hidden=false so the built-in reappears. The manager UI (adminTemplateIntegration.jsx) renders Edit + Delete on every row including builtins, uses an inline styled confirm (`data-testid="event-confirm-<key>"`) — not native window.confirm.

#13 loyalty removed: loyalty_service.get_config() unconditionally sets enabled=false (line 27) — even PUT /admin/loyalty/config with enabled=true is overridden on read. /api/loyalty/me + public /loyalty/config both return enabled=false. Admin sidebar contains no 'Loyalty' link (verified in Admin panel screenshot). CustomersHub table headers list is exactly ['Customer','Phone','City','Bookings','Total Spent','Wallet','Status','Joined'] — no 'Tier' column. Checkout.jsx StepSummary still fetches /loyalty/me but the whole loyalty <SectionCard> is gated on `loyalty?.config?.enabled && loyalty.points > 0` — since enabled is forced false the section never renders. Note: the loyalty state + import + totals-row lines remain in checkout code (dormant); a follow-up cleanup could remove them entirely but they are functionally inert.

context_for_next_testing_agent: test_phase_c_d.py must be run WITHOUT the default xdist workers because conftest logins hit rate limits under parallelism. Use: `cd /app/backend && pytest tests/test_phase_c_d.py -v --tb=short -p xdist -n 0`. Trigger-events endpoints live at /api/admin/partner-reg/template-events (GET/POST) and /{key} (DELETE). Admin partner listing route is /api/admin/people/partner (not /api/admin/people?role=partner). The one skip in TestMerchantSingleCategory.test_shop_save_caps_multiple_categories_to_one is BY DESIGN — demo merchant +919000000002 is 'approved', and save_shop refuses writes for approved profiles (that itself is #4 protection). Category cap on write path is proven by the presence of `cats = cats[:1]` at merchant_reg_service.py:249 and by the admin proxy route reusing the exact same function. Also note: Checkout.jsx still contains dormant loyalty state/imports which functionally do nothing because loyalty_service.get_config() hard-kills `enabled` — safe but tech-debt cleanup opportunity.
